title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask
shortDescription: A compact, surreal adventure that uses a repeating three-day cycle to make schedules, side stories, and transformation tools matter.
highlights: The clock turns local details into puzzles with human stakes
Masks create distinctive ways to move through and understand the world
keywords: The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A Nintendo 64 adventure pick for players drawn to inventive structure and densely interconnected side stories.
